name: land-no-pthread-single-profile
title: Land no-pthread single-profile runtime
description: Convert this fork to one browser-first no-pthread runtime profile. Remove SharedArrayBuffer/cross-origin-isolation requirements, adapt the native build and wrapper/release contracts, validate locally first, and trigger expensive remote native builds only after static and unit gates pass.
creator: killbus
notes: Qualified and published the single-profile no-pthread runtime from clean build 33412490741. Landing remains in progress while heavyweight runtime bytes are removed from Git LFS and all consumers are moved to deterministic restoration from the qualified release.
